fields.Name: W1 -> S3.2
fields.Description: Gate G1.11 (phase 1, dataset W1, criterion S3.2): for 20 sampled scored W1-signal s42 rows, every feature value resolves to its source, source version and computed-at, 20 of 20. It fails when the provenance's computed-at is not checked against its source, so resolved < 20 of 20.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 20 of 20 sampled scored W1 rows resolve every feature value to its source, source version and computed-at.
